card.name: On a regular basis: frequency phrases
card.fires_on: The word "on" right after a verb phrase, where "a regular/daily/annual basis" is about to follow. Also "more" or "as" just before "frequently".

modes.label: on ... basis

modes.label: more/as frequently

card.writes: It prepares a frequency phrase to come next, and it pushes down direct frequency words like periodic, regularly and frequent.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that opens a how-often phrase, such as "on a regular basis" or "more frequently".
